ObjectName.value: U S and Philippine Forces Integrate Battlefield Skills at Salaknib 2026 (9613445)

Categories.value: PD US Army|25th Infantry Division (United States)|Files created by the United States Army with known IDs|DVIDS files uploaded by OptimusPrimeBot|Milimedia files, Philippines (review needed)|21st Infantry Regiment (United States)|Philippines photographs taken on 2026-04-11|Salaknib 2026

ImageDescription.value: U.S. Army Sgt. Fernando Gonzalez, a forward observer assigned to the 2nd Battalion, 21st Infantry Regiment, 3rd Mobile Brigade, 25th Infantry Division, verifies a Philippine Army soldier's grid coordinates during foundational training activities as part of Exercise Salaknib 2026 at Fort Magsaysay, Philippines, April 11, 2026. This training on foundational land navigation skills ensures both forces share common tactics and procedures, which are essential for combined operations. Salaknib is an annual exercise designed to enhance interoperability and strengthen relationships between partner nations. (U.S. Army photo by Sgt. Duke Edwards)
